summary: Complete end-to-end validation of Rebuplica 27 (backend + frontend) via the public preview URL. 15/15 pytest cases pass (health, register, login, /auth/me, invalid seed, match CRUD, decision + flag + invalid-key, advance turn, events + replay consistency, save/duplicate conflict/restore, user isolation, Emergent OAuth session cookie + logout). 16/16 Playwright UI steps pass (register with short-password error, invalid-seed error, random seed, create match, Turn 0 / 2027 header, replay íntegro badge, apply inflation=4.2, invalid key '1abc' blocked client-side, SET_FLAG badge, advance 90 days, create save, duplicate save conflict, advance+restore back to Turno 1, timeline populated, logout, /dashboard protected after logout).

issues: React Router v6 future-flag warnings in console (v7_startTransition, v7_relativeSplatPath) — cosmetic only

critical_code_review_comments: Dashboard.create() swallows backend error details with a generic 'Não foi possível criar a partida.'; could surface failure.code (e.g. VALIDATION_ERROR vs RATE_LIMITED) for better UX, as done in Login.jsx.
DecisionForm only client-validates key format; good UX, but ensure 500/network failures also propagate a readable message (currently caught by generic fallback — fine).
React Router v6 future-flag warnings — add v7_startTransition / v7_relativeSplatPath opt-in to silence.
This report is historical: rerun E2E/UI tests after the auth and CORS changes; frontend Playwright source is not currently committed in this repository.
test_credentials: Redacted; E2E accounts must be generated per run. Do not commit usernames/passwords, tokens, or database credentials.
seed_data_creation: Tests create ephemeral users with random-suffix emails (ui.qa+<hex>, qa.rebuplica.second+<hex>, oauth.qa+<hex>) and new games per run; nothing destructive.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend E2E tests live at /app/backend/tests/test_backend_e2e.py and require REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. Use per-run credentials, never version credentials or live session tokens. OAuth-session test inserts a temporary row only in a dedicated local test database.
